MoleculeMind Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform User Service Agreement

Version release/update date: August 4, 2026·Version effective date: August 4, 2026

Welcome to the MoleculeMind Enterprise-User MoleculeOS protein structure prediction, optimization and design platform (the “Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform” or the “Platform”; for the avoidance of doubt, the Platform under this Agreement specifically refers to the MoleculeMind Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform) operated by Shanghai Moleculemind Group Co., Ltd. and its affiliates (“MoleculeMind” or “we”). The Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform focuses on supporting multi-step and highly interactive application scenarios, such as long-cycle processes including viewing, computing and analysis. For users such as enterprises, universities, colleges and research institutions (the “Enterprise Users” or “Users”), it provides AI-enhanced and workflow-simplified solutions, comprehensive context related to protein computation, and full-process tools to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of scientific research.

The MoleculeMind Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform User Service Agreement (this “Agreement”) is an agreement entered into between us and users, including enterprises and the account operators of Enterprise Users (“you”), regarding the rights and obligations of both parties in connection with your use of the Platform services. Please note that this Agreement includes all of the following terms, as well as various agreements and rules relating to the Platform that we have issued or may issue and update from time to time in the future (including activity rules, notices, instructions and announcements). Such agreements and rules also form an integral part of this Agreement and have the same legal effect as this Agreement.

To safeguard your lawful rights and interests, before you confirm your acceptance of this Agreement, please carefully read and fully understand all terms of this Agreement, especially the terms that exempt or reduce our liability or exclude or restrict your rights, which will be highlighted in bold. If you have any questions about this Agreement, you may contact us at mos@moleculemind.com. Your initial registration/login or commencement of use of any functional module of the Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform shall indicate that you have fully read, understood and accepted the entire contents of this Agreement, and agree to be bound by this Agreement as a party hereto, whereupon this Agreement is formed and becomes effective between you and us. If you do not agree to any provision of this Agreement, or cannot accurately understand the meaning of any provision, please do not proceed with subsequent operations and stop using the Platform services. In order to provide you with continuously optimized services, we have the right to amend the terms of this Agreement from time to time according to changes in national laws and regulations and the operational needs of the Platform. If you continue to use the Platform services after the foregoing changes become effective, you shall be deemed to have fully read, understood and accepted the amended agreement and to agree to be bound by it.

Please note that the Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform provides services only to Enterprise Users that meet the requirements of Article 1.1 of this Agreement. Legal persons, unincorporated organizations or unincorporated groups that do not meet the requirements of Article 1.1 of this Agreement, as well as natural persons, should not use the services of the Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform.

Article 1 Definitions and Interpretation

1.1 Users

means legal persons, unincorporated organizations and other unincorporated groups lawfully established under the laws and regulations of the mainland of the People’s Republic of China (the “PRC” or “China”) (for the avoidance of doubt, Mainland China means all territory of the People’s Republic of China excluding the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, the Macao Special Administrative Region and Taiwan), including without limitation pharmaceutical enterprises, chemical enterprises, universities, colleges and research institutions. During registration, login and use of the Platform services, Users must undertake to comply with applicable laws and regulations and all Platform rules.

1.2 Intellectual Property

means any copyrights, know-how, patent applications/granted patents, and/or any other similar intellectual property relating to the Enterprise-User MoleculeOS Platform and the information contained in or carried by it.

1.3 Confidential Information

means any/all information in any form owned or held by a party that has not been disclosed to the public, may bring certain economic interests or business competitive advantages to that party, and for which confidentiality measures have been adopted, including without limitation any invention or discovery of a party, any secret or confidential information or knowledge of a party, any operational or financial data of a party, any method used or developed by a party, and any operational or technical information owned by a third party with respect to which a party has confidentiality obligations.

1.4 User Business Data

means data entered, uploaded, imported, managed, generated or exported by a User in the course of using the Platform services that is related to the User’s scientific research, research and development, projects, pipelines or business, including without limitation amino acid or nucleic acid sequences, protein structure files, target information, protein files, molecular design parameters, wet-lab experimental data, project/pipeline data, and result data calculated, analyzed, predicted or generated by the Platform based on User instructions or User Business Data.

1.5 Operational Behavior Data

means data generated by Users during their use of the Platform, including account login, functional clicks, page visits, searches, task submissions, operating status, error logs, frequency of use, device and browser information, and other data relating to service experience, system security, risk control, functional statistics, and operation and maintenance. Such data does not include User Business Data itself.

1.6 Platform Outputs

means structure predictions, sequence/structure analyses, design recommendations, scores, visualization results, reports, logs or other computational results generated by the Platform based on User instructions, User Business Data, Platform algorithmic models, third-party databases or other tools. Platform Outputs are scientific research assistance results and do not constitute professional advice, factual warranties or commitments regarding commercial feasibility.

1.7 Place of Contract Performance

The Platform’s R&D team, operations management team, technical maintenance team, and financial settlement center are all located at the premises of Shanghai Moleculemind Group Co., Ltd.—specifically, 3/F, Building 1, Lane 999, Huanke Road, China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone. Core business activities under this Agreement—including daily operations, technical maintenance, and customer service—are conducted at this address; accordingly, this address constitutes the place of contract performance for this Agreement.

You acknowledge and agree that the aforementioned address is the place of contract performance for this Agreement. In the event of any dispute arising from or in connection with this Agreement, either party shall have the right to file a lawsuit with the competent People’s Court having jurisdiction over the place of contract performance.

Article 2 Platform Account Registration and Management

2.1 Registration Process

2.1.1 Platform accounts of Enterprise Users will be opened by the invited enterprise contacting us. The invited enterprise shall ensure that the registration information is complete, true and accurate and is the personal information of the account operator himself or herself, and shall not use another person’s email address or other information, or otherwise register an account by impersonating another person.

For any registration application that violates laws or regulations, Platform rules or our management requirements, we have the right to unilaterally refuse registration and may take further measures as appropriate.

2.2 Account Management and Security

If the relevant information changes, you shall promptly update it. You shall bear the relevant legal liabilities arising from your failure to update such information in a timely manner.

2.2.2 You may apply to register multiple accounts as needed for use of the services, but you may not maliciously or abnormally register and use multiple accounts. Services for each account are provided independently.

2.2.3 Users shall properly keep their Platform account and password information and shall bear legal liability for all operations conducted through their Platform accounts. If account information is leaked, lost or stolen due to reasons attributable to the User, the User shall independently bear all legal consequences arising therefrom, except where we are legally at fault and shall bear corresponding liability in accordance with law. Users shall not provide account information to others for use, nor authorize any third party to use their accounts in any manner. If you discover any account abnormality, theft or unauthorized use, you shall promptly notify us by email at mos@moleculemind.com, and we will assist you in taking necessary security measures after verification. You understand that we require a reasonable period of time to take action in response to any request from you, and that actions taken by us at your request may not avoid or prevent the occurrence or expansion of harmful consequences. You agree that, except where we are legally at fault and shall bear liability in accordance with law, we shall not bear any liability therefor. We recommend that Users change passwords regularly to enhance account security.

2.2.4 You shall ensure that all acts conducted using your MoleculeOS Platform account comply with applicable laws and regulations and this Agreement, and that you use the Platform services within the scope permitted by the Platform rules. If you violate the foregoing requirements or agreements, or if we have reason to believe that your acts have caused or may cause harm to the lawful rights and interests of us, other Platform users and/or third parties, we have the right to take measures including warnings, suspension or termination of use, functional restrictions and account recovery.
